moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description:
Rock (Physical)
Base Power: 25
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

moves.name: Beak Blast
moves.description:
Flying (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: -3
If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description:
Grass (Physical)
Base Power: 25
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description:
Flying (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description:
Flying (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description:
Flying (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description:
Steel (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.description:
Fire (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: King's Rock
items.description: Holder's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch. Evolves Poliwhirl into Politoed and Slowpoke into Slowking when traded.

items.name: Life Orb
items.description: Holder's attacks do 1.3x damage, and it loses 1/10 its max HP after the attack.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Expert Belt
items.description: Holder's attacks that are super effective against the target do 1.2x damage.

items.name: White Herb
items.description: Restores all lowered stat stages to 0 when one is less than 0. Single use.

items.name: Chilan Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a Normal-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Metronome
items.description: Damage of moves used on consecutive turns is increased. Max 2x after 5 turns.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.description: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times. Triple Kick and Triple Axel do not check accuracy for the second and third hits.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.description: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
